name: BEMT momentum-theory (T^1.5 + T2/V + v3 + climb/desc asym)
hypothesis: baseline 1,v,v2 misfits U-shaped rotor power; momentum theory gives NON-polynomial induced branch (T^1.5 hover, T^2/V forward relief) + parasite v^3 + climb/desc asymmetry — a form a linear term-library cannot reach

name: full-Glauert bridge + air-relative(wind) + thrust-coupled climb
hypothesis: replace iter1 two induced terms with ONE physically-correct Glauert bridge T2/sqrt(vh2+T); couple wind via air-relative speed sqrt(vh2+wind2) into profile/parasite; climb as T*max(vz,0) interaction
note: WORSE than iter1 (4.56->4.93%). The single correct bridge removed a DOF the two-term induced split gave the linear fit; wind-quadrature + thrust-climb did not compensate. More-principled lost to looser form.

name: iter1 core + thrust-scaled profile T*v2 (v2*payload interaction)
hypothesis: add v2*payload coupling via thrust-scaled profile T*v_h2 on top of iter1 winning core (heavier craft -> higher RPM -> more profile power at speed); interaction is a preferred novel form
note: MARGINAL KEEP: search 4.5558->4.5448% (0.24% rel), val 4.2465->4.2426%. Interaction barely helps once induced/payload core present -> diminishing returns, plateau+1.

name: iter3 + momentum-theory axial induced modulation (sqrt-of-sum, NON-poly)
hypothesis: climb lowers induced velocity v_i=-vz/2+sqrt((vz/2)^2+vi0^2), vi0^2~T; add T*(v_i-vi0) as non-polynomial vertical-induced signal beyond the polynomial library
note: NEAR-MISS: search 4.5448->4.5352% (only 0.096pp, BELOW 1e-4 keep-floor) and val 4.2426->4.2319% both improved but sub-significant -> REVERT. 2nd consecutive novel-form fail (after iter2 Glauert bridge). Honest boundary: compact induced+profile+parasite core ~4.24% ARE captures achievable kinematic signal; nonlinear refinements insignificant. plateau->3 => episode boundary next.

name: episode1: air-relative speed v_air=sqrt(v_h^2+wind^2) for aero drag (wind test)
hypothesis: lit(Tseng/Rodrigues) says wind is key and dataset measured it; test if gap to ~1.9% poly frontier is just wind via air-relative airspeed replacing ground speed in profile/parasite/forward-relief
note: REVERT: search 4.5448->4.5402% flat but val ARE 4.2426->4.3782% WORSE despite R2 0.251->0.257. Wind-quadrature helps per-sample variance a hair but hurts per-flight energy ARE. Gap is NOT simple air-relative wind -> likely wind direction (head/tail cancel in quadrature).

name: iter3 physics core + bare linear payload
hypothesis: diagnostic: single payload term=2.25% << physics-only 4.24%; physics loses because it forces payload into rigid T^1.5 shape. add bare linear payload -> should collapse to linear frontier, isolating that physics priors HURT by over-constraining payload->power
note: DECISIVE KEEP: search 4.5448->2.0080%, val 4.2426->1.9289%, R2 0.251->0.439 by adding ONE bare payload term. Now MATCHES full linear LIB (1.91%). Core finding: physics-nonlinear forms were NOT the value (were crippled by omitting linear payload); physics+payload(1.93%)~=pure-linear(1.91%). LLM physics reasoning neither beats nor clearly adds beyond flexible linear regression on real M100 energy. plateau->0.

name: iter6 + payload*climb interaction (weight-scaled climb work, beyond LIB)
hypothesis: best is at linear frontier (1.93%~1.91%); climb work=weight*climb-rate=(m0+payload)*g*vz so heavier pays more per climb; LIB lacks payload*climb product; test if this beyond-LIB interaction beats ~1.9%
note: REVERT: identical to iter6 (search 2.0080->2.0077%, val 1.9289->1.9288%, delta 0.0003pp << 1e-4). payload*climb adds nothing to per-flight energy ARE (climb is small fraction of total energy). Confirms ~1.9% is the frontier; beyond-LIB interactions do not beat it.

name: full linear LIB + physics(T^1.5,T2/V) — does physics beat linear?
hypothesis: decisive test: add physics non-poly on top of full linear LIB; below 1.91% => physics adds value, else physics adds nothing/ hurts
note: DECISIVE: pure-linear LIB val=1.909% is BEST (beats physics+payload iter6 1.929%). Physics ATOP linear -> val 1.909->1.962% WORSE (collinear cols overfit search split; per-sample R2 up 0.46 but per-flight ARE down). Physics neither beats nor adds to linear; stacked it HURTS. REVERT (mechanical search-KEEP met but true val worse + linear-stacking against mandate). Strong honest boundary.

name: iter6 + T^3 electrical I2R efficiency-loss (non-aero mechanism)
hypothesis: all prior novel forms aero/interaction & failed; try distinct ELECTRICAL mechanism: copper loss I2R ~ current^2 ~ (mech power)^2 ~ (T^1.5)^2 = T^3; non-LIB
note: REVERT: search 2.0080->2.0036% (0.0044pp, below 1e-4 floor), val 1.9289->1.9641% WORSE. T^3 collinear with T^1.5 over narrow mass range, overfits. Completes novel-form sweep: aero(induced/parasite/air-relative/axial) + interactions + electrical ALL fail to beat linear. plateau->3 => episode boundary next.

name: capstone defense-line comparison (baselines_energy.py)
note: loop 1.86% ties random 1.86% (structure-search weak); beats greedy 2.09%. code-level physics(1.93%) worse than random linear(1.86%). Contribution = trustworthy framework + honest boundary, not better model. Cross-consistent with radar.

name: Tseng + asym climb/desc (vz^3 climb / vz^2 desc)
hypothesis: from knowledge-base winner Tseng(1.90%), break v_z symmetry: independent nonlinear scale for climb(vz^3) vs descent(vz^2) — beyond linear LIB
note: search 1.991->1.988% (0.003pp, marginal past 1e-4 floor), val 1.903->1.918% WORSE (+0.015pp > +0.003 guard). Asymmetric climb/descent exponents overfit search split; symmetric v_z² was better. Another novel-form fails to beat simple linear from a strong starting point.

name: Tseng + piecewise hover/cruise (vh<2.5 segmented)
hypothesis: piecewise regime-split (hover vs cruise with independent scalings) — a structure linear polynomial library cannot express
note: PROTOCOL DISCIPLINE DEMO: piecewise better on ALL 3 val seeds (-0.006/-0.061/-0.014) but search mean worse (2.049 vs 1.991) due to seed0 spike (+0.347). Mechanical rule correctly REVERTs — val is a GUARD, never a selector (using val would leak it into selection → val-overfit). The piecewise structure may carry a tiny real signal (consistent val gain) but the protocol refuses to chase it; that is the anti-overfit discipline.
